target_customer: Risk-bearing healthcare organizations: health plans, IPAs, MSOs, ACOs and medical groups
problem: Quality, risk adjustment, pharmacy and care management teams work across fragmented claims, EHR, pharmacy, lab and ADT data. Pelica unifies it into one member record and gives them AI agents that complete work.
business_model: B2B SaaS, likely per member or platform fee (not confirmed)
product_category: Healthcare AI operating system for value-based care

founders.name: Lalit Kundu
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: led a 45+ engineer org; built Google Pay India infrastructure; ACM-ICPC World Finalist.

founders.name: Catherine Zhao
prior_employers: Google (APM and SWE, YouTube, ChromeOS, GenAI)
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: also clinical AI research at Stanford School of Medicine. The founders met at YouTube.

competitors.name: Innovaccer
competitors.what: Healthcare AI platform; launched a gap closure solution for payers covering risk adjustment and quality
competitors.traction_then: Established vendor; specific figures not found

technical_complexity.rationale: Ingesting and normalizing multi-source healthcare data into one record with HIPAA and SOC 2 controls plus agent workflows is substantial but built on existing technology.

defensibility.rationale: Deep data integration and compliance work create switching costs, but large health IT vendors and many agent startups target the same workflows.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents were launching similar capabilities in 2025; no acquisition of Pelica found as of late 2026.

market_need_then: Value-based care and Medicare Advantage star ratings create recurring spend on quality and risk adjustment work; the customer quote on the site says weekly eight-hour tasks drop to fifteen minutes, self reported.

identity.voice_and_tone: Enterprise healthcare, operational, claims specific numbers

brand_strength.rationale: Pronounceable coined name resembling pelican and other health brands; no press or community evidence about the brand.

outcome_analysis: Pelica is a Spring 2025 YC company, active in late 2026, with a named IPA customer on its site and a claim of 350,000 members served. Founders from Google and YouTube bring engineering depth, though healthcare domain depth is only partly shown by Zhao's clinical AI research. No exit found and funding amounts are not verified.
notes: Company site and YC page name backers (Y Combinator, SurgePoint Capital, Upside Partnership, ISEED Ventures, Progressive Ventures) but give no amounts or dates, so no round recorded.
